scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "pnpm --filter sense-web exec next dev -p 3000 || true" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && pnpm --filter sense-desktop start"
scripts.setup: pnpm config set ignore-scripts false --location project && pnpm install
scripts.clean:all: pnpm -w dlx rimraf node_modules **/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm -w store prune
scripts.doctor: node -v && pnpm -v && pnpm -w why electron && pnpm --filter sense-desktop exec electron --version
